partner.en: Hi, welcome! How many in your party?

task.zh: 換你說：你們有幾個人？想坐哪裡？
task.en: Your turn: say how many of you there are and where you'd like to sit.

partner.zh: 這邊請，這是菜單。要先點飲料嗎？
partner.en: Right this way. Here's the menu. Can I start you off with drinks?

task.zh: 換你說：你想喝什麼飲料？
task.en: Your turn: say what you'd like to drink.

partner.en: Are you ready to order?

reply.zh: 還沒，可以再給我們幾分鐘嗎？
reply.en: Not yet. Can we have a few more minutes?

task.zh: 換你說：說你準備好點餐了沒。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you're ready to order or need more time.

partner.en: Okay, what can I get for you today?

reply.zh: 我要一碗牛肉麵，不要香菜。
reply.en: I'd like the beef noodle soup, no cilantro.

task.zh: 換你說：點你想吃的，說有什麼不要加。
task.en: Your turn: order what you want to eat and mention anything you don't want in it.

partner.en: Anything else for you?

task.zh: 換你說：再加點一樣，或說先這樣。
task.en: Your turn: add something else to your order, or say that's all for now.

partner.en: How is everything tasting?

task.zh: 換你說：說說你覺得餐點怎麼樣。
task.en: Your turn: tell them what you think of the food.

partner.en: Can I get you some more water?

task.zh: 換你說：回答要不要，再要一樣你需要的東西。
task.en: Your turn: answer, and ask for anything else you need, like napkins.

partner.en: Can I take this plate for you?

task.zh: 換你說：說你吃完了沒有。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you're done with it or still eating.

partner.en: Would you like to see the dessert menu?

reply.en: I'm good. Can we get the check?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要不要甜點，或準備結帳了。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you want dessert or are ready to pay.

partner.zh: 總共六百八十元，付現還是刷卡？
partner.en: That's 680 dollars. Cash or card?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要怎麼付錢。
task.en: Your turn: say how you'd like to pay.

partner.en: Hi there, what can I get you?

reply.en: Can I get a bubble milk tea?

task.zh: 換你說：點一杯你想喝的飲料。
task.en: Your turn: order a drink you'd like.

partner.en: Medium or large?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要什麼大小。
task.en: Your turn: tell them what size you want.

partner.en: For here or to go?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要在這裡喝還是帶走。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you'll drink it here or take it with you.

partner.en: That'll be 70 dollars.

task.zh: 換你說：付錢給店員，說你給多少。
task.en: Your turn: hand over your money and say how much you're giving.

partner.zh: 這是你的號碼牌，好了會叫號。
partner.en: Here's your number. We'll call it when it's ready.

reply.en: Okay, about how long is the wait?

task.zh: 換你說：問一個關於等候的問題。
task.en: Your turn: ask something about the wait.

partner.en: How sweet would you like it?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要多甜。
task.en: Your turn: say how sweet you want your drink.

partner.en: And the ice? Regular ice?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要多少冰塊。
task.en: Your turn: say how much ice you want.

partner.en: Want to add boba or coconut jelly?

reply.en: Add boba, please. How much extra?

task.zh: 換你說：說你想加什麼料，或都不加。
task.en: Your turn: say what topping you want, or that you don't want any.

partner.en: Boba is ten dollars extra. Is that okay?

task.zh: 換你說：說加價可不可以。
task.en: Your turn: say if the extra cost is okay with you.

partner.en: Here's your drink. Straws are right over there.

reply.zh: 謝謝，可以給我一張紙巾嗎？
reply.en: Thanks. Could I get a napkin?

task.zh: 換你說：道謝，再跟店員要一樣你需要的東西。
task.en: Your turn: thank them and ask for something else you need.

partner.en: Is this everything for you?

reply.en: Yes, and a hot Americano, please.

task.zh: 換你說：說你還想加買什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say if there's anything else you want to buy.

partner.zh: 第二件六折，要不要再拿一瓶？
partner.en: The second one is 40% off. Want to grab another?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要不要買第二件。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you want a second one.

partner.en: Do you need a bag? It's two dollars.

reply.en: No, thanks. I brought my own bag.

task.zh: 換你說：說你需不需要袋子。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you need a bag.

partner.en: Do you want your receipt saved to your mobile barcode?

task.zh: 換你說：說你的發票要怎麼處理。
task.en: Your turn: say what you want to do with your receipt.

partner.zh: 總共一百二十五元，怎麼付款？
partner.en: That's 125. How would you like to pay?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要用什麼方式付錢。
task.en: Your turn: say how you'll pay.

title.en: Heating food, paying bills, picking up parcels

partner.zh: 這個便當要幫你加熱嗎？
partner.en: Do you want this bento heated up?

task.zh: 換你說：說你的東西要不要加熱。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you want your food heated.

partner.zh: 微波要兩分鐘，請旁邊稍等。
partner.en: It'll take two minutes. Please wait over there.

task.zh: 換你說：回應店員，說你會在哪裡等。
task.en: Your turn: answer and say where you'll wait.

partner.en: Next, please. What can I help you with?

reply.en: I'd like to pay this bill.

task.zh: 換你說：說你今天要辦什麼事。
task.en: Your turn: say what you need help with today.

partner.en: All set. Anything else?

reply.en: I also need to pick up a package.

task.zh: 換你說：說你還有沒有其他事要辦。
task.en: Your turn: say if there's anything else you need to do.

partner.zh: 請給我你的姓名和手機末三碼。
partner.en: Can I get your name and the last three digits of your phone?

reply.zh: 我姓王，末三碼是五二八。
reply.en: My last name is Wang. It's 528.

task.zh: 換你說：說出你的姓和手機末三碼。
task.en: Your turn: give your last name and the last three digits of your phone.

title.en: Finding things and trying them on

partner.en: Hi, are you looking for anything in particular?

task.zh: 換你說：說你在找什麼，或只是隨便看看。
task.en: Your turn: say what you're looking for, or that you're just browsing.

partner.zh: 這件是新款，要不要試穿看看？
partner.en: This one's new. Would you like to try it on?

task.zh: 換你說：說你想不想試穿。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you'd like to try it on.

partner.zh: 這件還有其他顏色，你喜歡哪個？
partner.en: It comes in other colors too. Which one do you like?

reply.en: I'd like to try the black one.

task.zh: 換你說：說你喜歡什麼顏色。
task.en: Your turn: say which color you'd like.

partner.en: How does it fit?

task.zh: 換你說：說衣服穿起來怎麼樣。
task.en: Your turn: say how the clothes fit you.

partner.en: Do you want to try a size up?

reply.en: Yes, could I get a size up?

task.zh: 換你說：說你想換哪個尺寸。
task.en: Your turn: say what size you want to try next.

partner.en: Is this one a better fit?

reply.en: It fits perfectly. I'll take it.

task.zh: 換你說：說合不合身，要不要買。
task.en: Your turn: say how it fits and whether you'll buy it.

partner.zh: 滿兩千打九折，還要看看別的嗎？
partner.en: Spend 2,000 and get 10% off. Anything else?

reply.en: Then I'll look at some pants too.

task.zh: 換你說：說你還想買什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say what else you might want to buy.

partner.zh: 結帳這邊請，刷卡還是付現？
partner.en: I can ring you up here. Card or cash?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要用什麼方式付款。
task.en: Your turn: say how you'd like to pay.

partner.en: Would you like it gift-wrapped?

task.zh: 換你說：說要不要包裝，是買給誰的。
task.en: Your turn: say if you want it wrapped and who it's for.

partner.zh: 這是發票，七天內可以退換喔。
partner.en: Here's your receipt. You can return it within seven days.

reply.en: Okay. Do I need the receipt to return it?

task.zh: 換你說：問一個關於退換貨的問題。
task.en: Your turn: ask a question about returns or exchanges.

partner.en: Hi, do you need some help?

reply.en: How do I get to the MRT station?

task.zh: 換你說：問路去一個你想去的地方。
task.en: Your turn: ask how to get to a place you want to go.

partner.zh: 直走到第二個路口再右轉。
partner.en: Go straight and turn right at the second light.

reply.en: So I turn right at the second light?

task.zh: 換你說：重複一次路線，確認你沒聽錯。
task.en: Your turn: repeat the directions back to make sure you got them.

partner.en: Yep, it's right next to the convenience store.

reply.en: How long does it take to walk?

task.zh: 換你說：問一個關於這條路的問題。
task.en: Your turn: ask another question about the way there.

partner.en: About five minutes. It's not far.

task.zh: 換你說：好好跟對方道謝。
task.en: Your turn: thank them in your own way.

partner.en: No problem. Are you visiting?

reply.en: Yes, I'm here for a week.

task.zh: 換你說：說你為什麼在這裡、待多久。
task.en: Your turn: say why you're here and how long you're staying.

partner.en: Which station are you going to?

reply.en: I'm going to Taipei Main Station.

task.zh: 換你說：說你要去哪一站。
task.en: Your turn: say which station you're going to.

partner.zh: 搭藍線就到了，不用轉車。
partner.en: Take the blue line. No need to transfer.

task.zh: 換你說：問一個搭車的問題。
task.en: Your turn: ask a question about the ride.

partner.zh: 上車刷卡，下車也要刷喔。
partner.en: Tap your card when you get on and off.

reply.en: Okay. Does this bus go to the night market?

task.zh: 換你說：問司機這班車有沒有到你要去的地方。
task.en: Your turn: ask the driver if this bus goes where you need to go.

partner.en: Hi, where to?

task.zh: 換你說：告訴司機你要去哪裡。
task.en: Your turn: tell the driver where you're going.

partner.en: Here we are. That'll be 230 dollars.

reply.en: Okay. Can I get a receipt, please?

task.zh: 換你說：付錢，並說你需不需要收據。
task.en: Your turn: pay and say whether you need a receipt.

title.en: Checking in and seeing the doctor

partner.en: Hi, do you have your health insurance card?

task.zh: 換你說：說你有沒有帶健保卡，是不是第一次來。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you have your card and if it's your first visit.

partner.en: What kind of doctor do you need to see?

reply.en: I'd like to see a family doctor.

task.zh: 換你說：說你要看哪一科。
task.en: Your turn: say what kind of doctor you need to see.

partner.en: So, what's bothering you today?

reply.en: I have a sore throat and a cough.

task.zh: 換你說：說你哪裡不舒服。
task.en: Your turn: describe your symptoms.

partner.en: How long has this been going on? Any fever?

task.zh: 換你說：說症狀多久了，有沒有發燒。
task.en: Your turn: say how long you've felt this way and if you have a fever.

partner.zh: 我開三天的藥給你，多喝水。
partner.en: I'll give you three days of medicine. Drink plenty of water.

task.zh: 換你說：問醫生一個你想知道的問題。
task.en: Your turn: ask the doctor a question you have.

partner.en: Hi, are you picking up a prescription?

task.zh: 換你說：說你今天來藥局要做什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say why you're at the pharmacy today.

partner.en: Are you allergic to any medications?

task.zh: 換你說：說你有沒有對什麼過敏。
task.en: Your turn: say whether you have any allergies.

partner.en: Take this three times a day after meals.

reply.en: Do I take it before bed too?

task.zh: 換你說：問一個怎麼吃藥的問題。
task.en: Your turn: ask a question about how to take the medicine.

partner.zh: 睡前不用。吃了可能會想睡覺。
partner.en: Not before bed. It might make you sleepy.

reply.en: So is it okay to drive?

task.zh: 換你說：問吃藥期間能不能做某件事。
task.en: Your turn: ask if you can do something while taking it.

partner.zh: 最好不要。還有其他問題嗎？
partner.en: Better not. Any other questions?

task.zh: 換你說：說你還有沒有問題。
task.en: Your turn: say if you have any other questions.

partner.zh: 歡迎！請問要辦理入住嗎？
partner.en: Welcome! Are you checking in?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要辦入住，有沒有訂房。
task.en: Your turn: say you're checking in and whether you booked.

partner.en: What name is the reservation under?

task.zh: 換你說：說出你訂房用的名字。
task.en: Your turn: say the name your booking is under.

partner.en: Can I see your passport, please?

task.zh: 換你說：回應對方，把證件拿給他。
task.en: Your turn: respond and hand over your ID.

partner.zh: 早餐六點半到十點，在二樓。
partner.en: Breakfast is 6:30 to 10 on the second floor.

reply.zh: 早餐有包含在房價裡嗎？

task.zh: 換你說：問一個關於早餐的問題。
task.en: Your turn: ask a question about breakfast.

partner.zh: 有的，這是房卡。還需要什麼嗎？
partner.en: Yes, it is. Here's your key card. Anything else?

task.zh: 換你說：問一件住宿需要知道的事。
task.en: Your turn: ask about something you need to know for your stay.

partner.zh: 櫃檯你好，請問有什麼需要？
partner.en: Front desk, how can I help you?

reply.en: The AC in my room isn't working.

task.zh: 換你說：說你房間有什麼問題。
task.en: Your turn: describe a problem with your room.

partner.zh: 不好意思，請問房號是幾號？
partner.en: I'm sorry about that. What's your room number?

task.zh: 換你說：說你的房號。
task.en: Your turn: give your room number.

partner.zh: 我們馬上請人上去看。還需要什麼嗎？
partner.en: We'll send someone right up. Anything else?

reply.zh: 可以多給我一條毛巾嗎？
reply.en: Could I get an extra towel?

task.zh: 換你說：跟櫃檯要一樣你需要的東西。
task.en: Your turn: ask for something else you need in your room.

partner.en: Good morning. Checking out?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要退房，把房卡還給櫃檯。
task.en: Your turn: say you're checking out and return your key.

partner.en: Great. How was your stay?

reply.en: It was great. I'll be back!

task.zh: 換你說：說說你住得怎麼樣。
task.en: Your turn: say how your stay was.

partner.zh: 嗨！我叫小美，你叫什麼名字？
partner.en: Hi! I'm Mei. What's your name?

reply.zh: 我叫大衛，很高興認識你。
reply.en: I'm David. Nice to meet you.

task.zh: 換你說：說你的名字，跟對方打招呼。
task.en: Your turn: tell them your name and say hi.

partner.en: Where are you from?

task.zh: 換你說：說你是哪裡人。
task.en: Your turn: say where you're from.

partner.en: What do you do?

task.zh: 換你說：說你的工作或在讀什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say what you do for work or school.

partner.en: What do you like to do on your days off?

reply.en: I like hiking and watching movies.

task.zh: 換你說：說你放假喜歡做什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say what you like to do in your free time.

partner.en: Really? I love hiking too!

task.zh: 換你說：回應對方，提議下次一起做點什麼。
task.en: Your turn: respond and suggest doing something together.

partner.en: Are you free this weekend?

task.zh: 換你說：說你什麼時候有空。
task.en: Your turn: say when you're free.

partner.en: Want to go to the night market together?

reply.en: Sure! What time should we meet?

task.zh: 換你說：說你想不想去，再問一個細節。
task.en: Your turn: say if you want to go and ask about a detail.

partner.zh: 晚上七點，在捷運站出口見？
partner.en: How about 7 p.m. at the MRT station exit?

task.zh: 換你說：說時間地點可不可以，或提出別的建議。
task.en: Your turn: say if the time and place work for you, or suggest another.

partner.zh: 二號出口。我們交換電話吧？
partner.en: Exit 2. Want to swap numbers?

task.zh: 換你說：回應對方，說怎麼聯絡你比較方便。
task.en: Your turn: respond and say the best way to reach you.

partner.en: Great, see you Saturday!

task.zh: 換你說：跟對方道別。
task.en: Your turn: say goodbye in your own way.

partner.en: Morning! How was your weekend?

reply.en: Pretty good. I went to the beach.

task.zh: 換你說：說你週末做了什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say what you did over the weekend.

partner.zh: 中午要不要一起訂便當？
partner.en: Want to order lunch together?

reply.en: Sure. What are you guys getting?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要不要一起訂，想吃什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say if you want in and what you feel like eating.

partner.zh: 我們都點雞腿便當，你呢？
partner.en: We're all getting the chicken leg bento. You?

task.zh: 換你說：說你要點什麼。
task.en: Your turn: tell them what you'd like to order.

partner.en: What project are you working on these days?

reply.en: I'm working on next week's presentation.

task.zh: 換你說：說你最近在忙什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say what you've been busy with lately.

partner.zh: 辛苦了！需要幫忙再跟我說。
partner.en: Sounds like a lot! Let me know if you need help.

reply.zh: 謝謝，我可能會找你幫忙。
reply.en: Thanks, I might need your help.

task.zh: 換你說：回應同事的好意。
task.en: Your turn: respond to their offer.

partner.zh: 大家到齊了嗎？我們開始開會。
partner.en: Is everyone here? Let's get started.

reply.zh: 等一下，還有一個人在路上。
reply.en: Wait, one more person is on the way.

task.zh: 換你說：說人到齊了沒，可不可以開始。
task.en: Your turn: say whether everyone's here and if you can start.

partner.en: How's your part coming along?

reply.zh: 差不多完成了，週五可以交。
reply.en: It's almost done. I can send it Friday.

task.zh: 換你說：報告你的工作進度。
task.en: Your turn: give an update on your work.

partner.en: Does anyone have any questions?

task.zh: 換你說：提出一個你想問的問題。
task.en: Your turn: ask a question you have about the meeting.

partner.en: That's it for today. You wanted to see me?

reply.en: I'd like to take tomorrow off.

task.zh: 換你說：說你想哪天請假。
task.en: Your turn: say which day you'd like to take off.

partner.en: Sure. Is your work covered?

reply.en: Yes, a coworker will cover for me.

task.zh: 換你說：說你的工作安排好了沒，誰會幫你。
task.en: Your turn: say how your work will be handled while you're out.

partner.en: Hi there, are you calling to make a reservation?

reply.en: Yes, I'd like to book for Friday night.

task.zh: 換你說：說你想訂哪一天。
task.en: Your turn: say which day you'd like to book.

partner.en: Sure. For how many, and what time?

task.zh: 換你說：說人數和時間。
task.en: Your turn: give the number of people and the time.

partner.zh: 七點客滿了，七點半可以嗎？
partner.en: We're booked at seven. Does 7:30 work?

task.zh: 換你說：說這個時間可不可以，不行就提別的。
task.en: Your turn: say if that time works, or suggest another.

partner.zh: 請問貴姓？留一支電話給我。
partner.en: Can I get a name and phone number?

reply.zh: 我姓林，打這支電話就可以。
reply.en: It's Lin. You can reach me at this number.

task.zh: 換你說：說你的姓和電話。
task.en: Your turn: give your name and phone number.

partner.en: Got it. Will you need a high chair?

task.zh: 換你說：說你們有沒有特別需求。
task.en: Your turn: mention any special requests you have.

partner.zh: 你好，請問想預約什麼服務？
partner.en: Hi! What would you like to book?

reply.en: I'd like to book a haircut.

task.zh: 換你說：說你想預約什麼。
task.en: Your turn: say what you'd like to book.

partner.en: Does tomorrow at 3 p.m. work?

task.zh: 換你說：說哪個時間你方便。
task.en: Your turn: say what time works for you.

partner.en: We have an opening Saturday at 10 a.m.

task.zh: 換你說：確認預約時間。
task.en: Your turn: confirm the appointment time.

partner.en: Do you have a stylist you'd like?

task.zh: 換你說：說你有沒有想指定的人。
task.en: Your turn: say if you want a specific person.

partner.zh: 好的。如果要改時間，請提早一天說喔。
partner.en: Okay. If you need to reschedule, please let us know a day ahead.

reply.zh: 好，要改時間我會先打來。
reply.en: Okay, I'll call ahead if I need to change it.

task.zh: 換你說：回應對方，說如果有變動你會怎麼做。
task.en: Your turn: respond and say what you'll do if your plans change.
